package.name: kb_skills
package.description: KnowledgeCore client helpers and formal skill metadata for KB interactions.

export.skill: id: kb_query version: 1.0.0 description: | Query symbolic scene state from KnowledgeCore through the canonical `/kb/query` service. This is the phase-1 read-only KB surface used for chatbot grounding and future planner-facing scene lookups. interface: service default_interface_path: /kb/query datatype: kb_msgs/srv/Query functional_domains: - knowledge - perception parameters: in: - name: patterns type: string[] required: true description: Triple-pattern list sent to KnowledgeCore. - name: vars type: string[] required: true description: Variables projected in the query response. - name: models type: string[] default: [] description: Optional model scope used by the query. out: - name: json type: string description: JSON array of KnowledgeCore bindings. - name: success type: boolean description: True if KnowledgeCore accepted and answered the query. - name: error_msg type: string description: Error string returned by KnowledgeCore on failure.

id: kb_revise version: 1.0.0 description: | Update or revise symbolic state in KnowledgeCore through the canonical `/kb/revise` service. This is the main planner-facing mutation seam for refreshing world facts without exposing raw ROS transport details. interface: service default_interface_path: /kb/revise datatype: kb_msgs/srv/Revise functional_domains: - knowledge - planning parameters: in: - name: statements type: string[] required: true description: Statements to update in KnowledgeCore. - name: models type: string[] default: [] description: Optional model scope used by the mutation. - name: lifespan_sec type: float default: 0.0 description: Optional lifespan used for transient grounded facts. out: - name: success type: boolean description: True if the revise request succeeded. - name: error_msg type: string description: Error string returned by KnowledgeCore on failure.

id: kb_add version: 1.0.0 description: | Add new symbolic facts through `/kb/revise` using the `add` mutation operation. This is intended for planner- or tool-driven persistent KB assertions. interface: service default_interface_path: /kb/revise datatype: kb_msgs/srv/Revise functional_domains: - knowledge - planning parameters: in: - name: statements type: string[] required: true description: Statements to add to KnowledgeCore. - name: models type: string[] default: [] description: Optional model scope used by the mutation. out: - name: success type: boolean description: True if the add request succeeded. - name: error_msg type: string description: Error string returned by KnowledgeCore on failure.

id: kb_remove version: 1.0.0 description: | Remove symbolic facts through `/kb/revise` using the `remove` operation. This is the planner-facing seam for retracting obsolete or invalidated symbolic state. interface: service default_interface_path: /kb/revise datatype: kb_msgs/srv/Revise functional_domains: - knowledge - planning parameters: in: - name: statements type: string[] required: true description: Statements to retract from KnowledgeCore. - name: models type: string[] default: [] description: Optional model scope used by the mutation. out: - name: success type: boolean description: True if the remove request succeeded. - name: error_msg type: string description: Error string returned by KnowledgeCore on failure.
